title: AI Discovery Platform
description: Two interview workflows uncover organizational pain points and translate ideas into developer-ready specifications. Includes provider-independent interview orchestration, structured decision logs, background workers and an API/web application architecture.
features: Interview employees to surface workflow bottlenecks and automation opportunities
Turn early product ideas into structured developer-ready specifications
Record decisions, assumptions and implementation requirements
Separate interview engine, provider integration, API, jobs and web application
workflow: Capture the starting problem or idea
Convert answers into requirements and recorded decisions
Produce a specification suitable for implementation planning
summary: Two AI interview workflows: one interviews employees to surface workflow bottlenecks and automation opportunities, the other turns early product ideas into developer-ready specifications. Decisions, assumptions and requirements are recorded as it goes.
